summary.headline: Afternoon sun, 1 to 4 hours a day
summary.subline: From about 13:30 until about 16:45. Most in March, least in June.

advice:
Verdict: This west-facing spot gets brief hot afternoon sun year-round, strongest in Mar at 3.8 h and weakest in Jun at 1.2 h.
Blocked by: distant high-rise towers to the west
Good for: warm winter afternoon sits, heat-loving potted olives, quick evening laundry drying
Not for: midday summer sunbathing, shade-loving plants, large solar panels
Tip: Add a light shade screen for summer afternoons and move the chair out of direct glare.
